<Dragon World>
[AUTO](VC)[1/Turn]: When this unit attacks, [COST][rest] one rear-guard, and during that battle, the unit that was [rested] with this cost and this unit enter a linked attack state. (Units in coordinated attack add up their power)
[AUTO](VC)[Once per Turn]: At the end of the battle in which this unit attacked, [COST][Counter Blast (1)], choose one of your rear-guards in linked attack mode, and make it [Stand]. If your opponent's vanguard is grade 3 or higher, choose one of your rear-guards that includes "Drum", and make it [Stand].
my buddy! - [Activate] [V] [Once per Turn]: [Cost] [Soul Blast (1)], search your deck or drop for up to one "Drum Bunker Dragon", call it to (RC), and during that turn, the cost of the [Activate] ability that that unit originally has is reduced by 1 gauge. [CONT]: This card cannot be ridden.
[Call Cost] [Pay 2 gauge and retire 1 rear guard]
